title: Coherence of specified ordinary action-site tensor and Hom restriction
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J, let s be a continuous site autoequivalence whose inverse is continuous, let R be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let a identify inverse-translation of R with R. Fix a twisted action-site Presentation P [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data]. Put U = P.modules.functor followed by forgetPairs(sigma J s R a). There exists a RingedForgetTensorTransposition.Underived structure on U [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data] whose Hom comparison at each pair (M,N) has forward map exactly P.hom(M,N).hom. The proposed construction assembles P.tensor and P.hom using their naturality and uses P.unit, but extra tensor/unit equalities are not asserted. This asserts coherence and evaluation for specified maps, without any native Frobenius realization or existence of sites.

proof.text: Assemble the components P.tensor and P.hom into natural isomorphisms by NatIso.ofComponents, using P.tensor_naturality and P.hom_naturality. Take P.unit as the unit comparison.

proof.text: For associativity precompose by the two inverse tensor comparisons. Maps out of a triple sheaf tensor are determined by local pure triples: cancel the sheafified tensor of the sheafification units, apply the sheafification adjunction, and use tensor induction three times. Apply P.tensor_pure twice, restriction naturality and the pure-triple associator formula. Both paths give x tensor (y tensor z). For the two unit equations apply the two-variable pure tensor criterion and P.unit_sections. Coefficient restriction is a ring isomorphism, so both paths multiply the module section by the same coefficient. P.symmetry gives the symmetry equation.

proof.text: The pure-tensor characterization IsSheafEvaluation uniquely determines right evaluation by the sheafification adjunction and sectionwise tensor induction. The canonical right evaluation is braiding followed by the ordinary left evaluationMap. Substitute P.evaluation and P.symmetry. Tensor naturality moves P.hom through the braiding and gives the displayed Underived evaluation equation for every pair of evaluations satisfying that characterization. All data are fixed; zero modules, empty sites and zero rings satisfy the same calculations.

theorem underived_restriction (P : Presentation J s R a) :
    letI := P.category
    let U := P.modules.functor ⋙ forgetPairs (sigma J s R a)
    ∃ d : RingedForgetTensorTransposition.Underived.{u, u, u, u, u, u}
        P.topology P.coefficient J R U,
      ∀ M N : Modules P.coefficient,
        d.hom.hom.app (op M, N) = (P.hom M N).hom
